jurisdiction.label: geography.location.country_code
jurisdiction.why: GLEIF's jurisdiction code: an ISO 3166-1 country code, or a country-plus-subdivision code such as US-DE. No taxonomy label names that union. Every value begins with the country, so country code is the nearest label that is true of the column; state code, which inference published, is false of the country-only rows. The pattern stays widened in descriptor.overrides.json to admit the subdivision suffix, the same union gleif.jurisdiction declares.

tier.label: representation.text.word
tier.why: One of four lowercase provenance words: authoritative, confirmed, candidate or ambiguous. Inferred, some samples of this column read those words as month names.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: A derived search field: display name, legal name, ticker and LEI, lowercased, accent-stripped and concatenated. It is free text by construction. Inferred, samples of this column come back `plain_text`, `unknown` or an identifier type depending on the run.

reg_status.label: representation.text.word
reg_status.why: GLEIF's LEI registration status, a single upper-case token such as ISSUED or LAPSED: the same register element gleif.registration_status carries, declared with the same label.

company_name.label: representation.text.entity_name
company_name.why: The SEC display name of the registrant, carried through the join. Inferred, the label is a draw between samples; declared, it carries the label edgar.company_name carries.
